description: Search memory in its base_language (turn/step_zero report base_language: write query/search_as in it). Newest first; older conflicting facts marked superseded_by; time per hit. Prefer turn. Full text: memory_event.

query.description: Search text in the memory base_language (turn/step_zero report base_language); keep names and exact terms.

search_as.description: Optional, recommended when the user asks a question about the past: up to 3 short statements of how the answer was most likely WRITTEN in memory - statement form, not a question; first person as the speaker said it ("my kids loved...", "I went to...") and third person with names; in the memory's base_language (turn/step_zero report it; translate the question if the user wrote in another language; keep names); never invent the unknown fact. Searched together with the question (finds answers a question-shaped query misses, esp. cross-language).

name: memory_search
